Title: The Chats
Description: Straight from Australia’s Sunshine Coast, The Chats are bringing their raw, unpolished punk rock to AB! Since their viral hit ‘Smoko’, the trio have become one of the most exciting punk bands around. Short, fast tracks, sharp riffs and a healthy dose of Australian humour. The Chats describe their own genre as ‘shed rock’. Following ‘High Risk Behaviour’ and ‘Get Fucked’, their new album ‘ HALF CUT’ is due for release in March 2027.

Title: Amenra
Description: AMENRA will return to AB in 2027. These will be the first heavy metal shows of the year for the band from Kortrijk and, at the same time, their only Belgian gig of 2027. For over twenty years, AMENRA have been developing their own distinctive sound, somewhere between post-metal, doom and sludge. Their music revolves around loss, pain and connection, characterised time and again by that intense alternation between subdued passages and crushing outbursts. Their concerts have since become a fixture at AB, where they have sold out several nights in a row in recent years. With frontman Colin H. Van Eeckhout, stark black-and-white visuals and impressive dynamics, AMENRA continues to deliver a unique live experience every single time.
